Common questions

Good to know before we start.

How long does a website take?

Most Starter and Business sites take around 4–8 weeks once the scope and content are agreed. We set a project timeline before work begins.

Will I own my website?

Yes. Build-only projects are handed over when the final balance is paid. Managed monthly sites can be transferred at the end of the agreed term.

Can you improve my current website?

Yes. We can review what is working, then improve the design, speed, content structure or enquiry process.

What happens after launch?

You can manage the site yourself or ask us to handle hosting, updates, maintenance and ongoing improvements.
